# Report - video47, L1 proxy, CineRecon Three.js sampled-frame baseline

Level: L1 (proxy). This is the Three.js sampled-frame baseline. It is not a protocol-equivalent reproduction of Blender model rankings.

## Observed in the 24 reference samples
- 0-3.2 s: a red-haired rider in dark maroon clothing, with a bow on her back, runs away from the camera along a pale dirt path. A third-person camera sits behind and above her and is yawed right, so she and the path's vanishing point sit left of centre. There are trees and red flower beds on the left, and a green hill, a red-dirt slope and thin trees on the right.
- 3.65-5.0 s: the camera is low and tilted up, with the sun at upper right. A large dark purple winged machine with a blue glowing crest lands on the path, flaring its wings, and faces image-left. The rider leaps up beside it (4.55 s) and flips high above its back (5.02 s).
- 5.47-10.49 s: a different viewpoint (treated as a cut). The mount, carrying the rider, takes off from low near the ground, beats its wings and climbs. It then glides away from the camera on the left of frame while the camera follows behind-right, climbing and turning right. The path recedes ahead, with rock spires, a cliff, red flowers and trees.

## Geometry and articulation
- Rider: an articulated proxy with pelvis, torso, head with a hair block, a bow, and 2-segment arms and legs. It uses a procedural run cycle, a tucked forward flip for the leap, and a seated riding pose attached to a saddle anchor on the mount.
- Mount: an ellipsoid body, a neck and head pivot, an emissive crest, a cone tail, and two-segment wings (shoulder plus elbow, with 3 tip feathers each). It also has two-segment legs. Wings flap, fold and glide; legs extend for landing and tuck in flight.
- Environment: a ground plane, path strips, scaled-sphere hills, bushes and flower beds, cylinder-and-sphere trees, cone rocks, a gradient sky dome, clouds and a sun disc. Separate environment groups are used for the two locations.

## Camera and timing
- Follow camera until 3.25 s, then a fast blend (3.25-3.55 s) to the low landing view. A hard cut at 5.25 s goes to the flight shot. The flight camera path is integrated deterministically from heading and speed keys at init time.
- All motion is sampled absolutely from time, using keyframe Hermite curves and analytic cycles.

## Inference / uncertainty
- Whether 3.2-3.65 s is a cut or a continuous camera move is inferred. The exact cut time between 5.02 and 5.47 s is inferred. So are the mount's facing during landing, the rider's path between samples, the wing-beat phase between samples, and all world distances.
- The HUD overlay in the reference is not reproduced (it is UI, not scene).

## Feedback
- Initial generation; no render feedback has been received yet.

rounds.reason: Fix run-camera distance, mount scale, flight orientation and leg tuck.
